stripe.title: Set up Stripe
stripe.status: This preview unlocks the level on this device. No payment is collected.
steps: In a Stripe sandbox, create products and prices for YHWH Pro and Zanmen Elite. Create a Payment Link for each.
For Pro, create a coupon and a promotion code named YHWH, then enable promotion codes on the Payment Link. Test checkout in the sandbox.
Before taking live payments, activate the Stripe account. Verify signed Checkout webhooks on your server and grant the matching level only after confirming payment. Keep Stripe secrets on the server.
